description: Quaternion and UnitQuaternion: product, conjugate, inverse, axis-angle, scaled axis, rotation matrix conversions, vector transforms, slerp, nlerp, rotation_between, euler angles, linearized axis-angle update

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: quaternion_mul
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: quaternion_conjugate
ops.tolerance: 0: exactly representable, no rounding involved

ops.name: quaternion_norm
ops.tolerance: 2 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: quaternion_normalize
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 2 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: quaternion_try_inverse
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_mul
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: unit_quaternion_inverse
ops.tolerance: 0: exactly representable, no rounding involved

ops.name: unit_quaternion_from_axis_angle
ops.tolerance: 6 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: unit_quaternion_from_scaled_axis
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_scaled_axis
ops.tolerance: ceil(24 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_angle
ops.tolerance: ceil(24 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_angle_to
ops.tolerance: ceil(24 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix
ops.tolerance: 4 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: unit_quaternion_from_rotation_matrix
ops.doc: UnitQuaternion::from_rotation_matrix(&r) (sign as upstream: compare up to sign if your branch selection differs)
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_inverse_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_slerp
ops.doc: a.slerp(&b, t): shortest arc (upstream negates b when a.dot(b) < 0), 0.05 < |a.dot(b)| < 0.95
ops.tolerance: ceil(32 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_nlerp
ops.doc: a.nlerp(&b, t): plain lerp + normalize, no shortest-arc flip; a.dot(b) > -0.9
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_rotation_between
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_euler_angles
ops.tolerance: ceil(24 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_from_euler_angles
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_append_axisangle_linearized
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
